1531.words: Please stop the sequence and tell me who you are / I will cease all response; silent from Nine through the whole of day 3

1542.words: I am not going to say seven… If you want to speak, speak / I am done counting; day 3 'You are speaking to a wall that does not exist… Goodbye'
